propositions: The per-edge, same-edge cascade guarantee of _CASCADING_EDGES must be narrowed from the over-broad 'A child never runs ahead of its parent in the lifecycle' headline to accurately reflect what the enumerated table actually enforces

Reactivating a closed child under an open parent does not cascade (documented residual 1): only a closed parent is eligible on that edge, and an in_progress child under an open parent does not violate the required invariant

The blocked→in_progress resume must be resolved as documented non-cascading despite the start-work gate firing on it, because only a blocked parent would be eligible on that edge and auto-resuming an independently-blocked parent would be incorrect

The required invariant 'no non-terminal-state ticket can be a child of a closed ticket' is enforced jointly by the two closed-source rows of _CASCADING_EDGES and the unconditional open-children close guard in transition_close.py

Documentation and comments in docs/concurrency.md §I4a, _CASCADING_EDGES, and transition.py docstrings must reconcile the gate-vs-cascade disagreement, with no changes to transition logic, table rows, or txn.claim_core
